g.text: 18. gap (right): the field engine, rung 1, "veterans", seed 1, 83.75 s to 118.75 s
in the front rank, the slot on his right exists and is empty. Men: 26. Body: hastati, first century.
+ a slot, joined to its man when he is away from it · □ the standard · ○ the men the flag is about · red line: a bout
